name: iOS27 Animation
tagline: 为iOS15–18带来iOS27风格的系统动画。
notice: 售价10元，一个激活码仅限绑定1台设备。购买请加入QQ群1126594257联系群主。只要CF不倒，激活码永久有效，升级后首次使用请保持联网。72小时仅为连续离线使用上限，并非授权有效期。
description: iOS27 Animation为App打开与最小化、切换App、解锁、通知、系统窗口、文件夹和控制中心提供iOS27风格的动画。
支持统一默认配置或各场景独立设置，提供App开合时长调节、支持直接输入数值的弹簧强度滑杆，以及可选的最小化同步桌面图标动画。
features: App打开与最小化漏斗动画
切换App转场
解锁进入桌面动画
通知与系统窗口动画
文件夹与控制中心动画
统一默认配置与场景独立设置
App开合时长倍率0.5–3
各场景弹簧独立开关与1.0–5.0强度滑杆
双行滑杆与数值直接输入
可选最小化同步桌面图标动画
按需开启诊断日志并导出诊断文件
设备激活、最长72小时离线使用与本机反激活
简体中文、繁體中文与English设置
usage: 安装后从系统“设置”进入“iOS27 动画”，开启插件并完成授权。配置可提前编辑，动画生效仍需有效授权。
购买：加入QQ群1126594257联系群主，10元一个激活码，仅限绑定1台设备。
先开启“启用插件”，再激活授权并选择默认或各场景配置；未激活时保持系统动画。
App时长倍率数值越大越慢；弹簧强度向右滑动越强，也可点击数值直接输入；修改从下一次动画生效，无需重载。
换机前请在原设备选择“反激活当前设备”，联网完成后即可释放名额。原设备不可用时，请保留激活码和恢复码并联系管理员。
设置中可复制QQ群号及Banana源地址，并打开Discord社区：https://discord.gg/vzWgenGeX6

changes: 优化App开合圆角及图标与内容的渐变衔接，改善桌面与Dock的收尾效果。
优化冷启动首帧交接，减少偶发的全屏画面闪现。
动画时长、弹簧强度滑杆改为双行布局，支持直接输入数值。
新增App开合时长调节，以及各场景独立的弹簧开关和强度滑杆。
新增最小化同步桌面图标动画，优化App与图标交接及大图标显示。
改善Bootstrap授权兼容与设置交互，购买说明改为一个激活码绑定一台设备。
优化 App 打开、关闭动画。
改善录屏时的流畅度，修复图标小尾巴。
改善通知横幅边缘闪烁，优化控制中心与第三方布局插件的兼容性。
升级授权功能，新增“反激活当前设备”，联网完成后立即释放该设备名额。
优化解锁与通知中心收起动画，改善图标飞入卡顿和突然跳变。
优化App打开与最小化时的图标衔接，减少闪烁和收尾位置异常。
修复转场中的潜在崩溃，改善控制中心与第三方布局插件的兼容性。
优化总开关与授权联动，关闭时停止动画和自动验证，保留已有激活资料。
修正通知中心闪烁、控制中心显示与收起残影、iOS16文件夹关闭白闪，并补齐锁屏新通知动画。
改进RootHide授权存储与旧数据迁移，保留原设备绑定和离线授权。
首次正式发布，提供App转场、多任务、解锁、通知、系统窗口、文件夹与控制中心动画。
支持按场景选择效果和App动画减速。
加入设备激活、自助换绑及购买与社区入口。

en.name: iOS27 Animation
en.notice: US$2 per activation code, for one device. Join QQ group 1126594257 and contact its owner to purchase. Activation codes remain valid permanently as long as Cloudflare remains available. Stay online for the first use after upgrading. The 72-hour limit applies only to continuous offline use, not the validity of your license.
description: iOS27 Animation brings iOS27-style effects to App opening and minimizing, app switching, unlock, notifications, system windows, folders, and Control Center.
Use a shared default or per-scene settings, adjust App animation duration and spring strength with sliders or direct numeric input, and optionally animate desktop icons during minimization.
features: Funnel animations for App opening and minimizing
App switching transitions
Unlock-to-home animation
Notification and system window animations
Folder and Control Center animations
Shared default and per-scene settings
0.5–3 duration multiplier for App opening and closing
Independent per-scene spring switches and 1.0–5.0 strength sliders
Two-row sliders with direct numeric input
Optional desktop icon animation during minimization
Optional diagnostic logging and export
Device activation, up to 72 hours offline, and on-device deactivation
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese settings
usage: Open iOS27 Animation from the system Settings app, enable the tweak, and activate your license. Configuration can be edited beforehand; effects still require a valid license.
To purchase, join QQ group 1126594257 and contact its owner. Each code costs US$2 and is valid for one device.
Enable the main switch, activate your license, and choose shared or per-scene effects. System animations remain in use until activation.
A higher duration multiplier slows App animations. Drag spring strength right for a stronger bounce; tap a value for direct input. Changes apply to the next animation without a respring.

Before switching devices, choose “Deactivate This Device” on the old device and complete the operation online to release its slot. If the old device is unavailable, keep your activation and recovery codes and contact the administrator.
Settings includes the QQ group, Banana repository, and Discord community: https://discord.gg/vzWgenGeX6

changes: Improves corners and icon-to-content crossfades when opening and minimizing apps, with smoother Home Screen and Dock handoff.
Improves the first-frame handoff during cold launches to reduce occasional full-screen flashes.
Updates duration and spring strength sliders to a two-row layout with direct numeric input.
Adds App opening/closing duration controls and independent per-scene spring switches and strength sliders.
Adds optional desktop icon animations during minimization and improves icon handoff and enlarged-icon display.
Improves Bootstrap license compatibility and Settings interaction. Purchase terms now specify one device per activation code.
Improves app opening and closing animations.
Improves smoothness during screen recording and fixes trailing icon artifacts.
Reduces notification banner edge flicker and improves Control Center compatibility with third-party layout tweaks.
Upgrades licensing with “Deactivate This Device”; its device slot is released immediately once online deactivation completes.
Improves unlock and Notification Center dismissal animations, reducing stutters and sudden jumps during icon arrival.
Improves the icon handoff when opening and minimizing apps, reducing flicker and incorrect landing positions.
Fixes potential transition crashes and improves Control Center compatibility with third-party layout tweaks.
Disabling the main switch now stops animations and automatic license checks while preserving activation data.
Corrects Notification Center flashing, Control Center display and dismissal artifacts, iOS16 folder flashes, and missing lock-screen notification animations.
Improves RootHide license storage and migration while retaining device bindings and offline access.
First release with App transitions, multitasking, unlock, notifications, system windows, folders, and Control Center animations.
Per-scene effects and optional slower App animations.
Device activation, self-service transfers, and purchase and community links.
